label: scan_consistency
type: the enumeration governing how current the index scan behind a query must be (not_bounded | at_plus | request_plus | statement_plus)
note: Promoted in round 10 by verify-promotions.py, not by a reconciler reading records. Recurs across six files in three trees (cloud/n1ql, cloud/indexes, cloud/clusters/analytics-service, java-sdk, server/current/n1ql), and one of those records states 'reused - already promoted' - a claim that was simply false. That false claim is the clearest single vindication of the new check: a record can assert its own provenance confidently and be wrong, and only a file-existence test notices. Two labels appear across the corpus and they are NOT two concepts: the four-valued form here is the query setting's own enum (server/current/n1ql/n1ql-manage/query-settings.md names not_bounded, at_plus, request_plus and statement_plus), while the Java SDK's QueryScanConsistency exposes a two-member subset (Not Bounded / Request Plus). Subset-of-an-enum, not a naming collision - deliberately distinguished from the index-state ConceptScheme, which governs GSI index lifecycle and shares nothing with this.
